agent_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'cwi:kingcode'. Prefix namespaces the issuing organization.

principal.description: The human at the root. kind is fixed to 'human': chains that do not terminate at a human fail verification.

description: A delegation receipt records one grant of authority from a delegator agent to a delegatee agent. Receipts form a tamper-evident hash chain; every receipt must walk back to a human principal. Versioned 1.0.0. Canonical spec: delegation/spec.md (same directory).

action.description: Machine-readable action identifier, e.g. 'run-department-lane'. Reserved: 'revoke-delegation' (must name the revoked receipt_id in constraints).

constraints.description: Limits bounding the delegation: cadence, approval gates, briefs to follow.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. A verifier SHOULD treat a receipt used after expires_at as lapsed authority.

forbidden.description: Explicitly out-of-scope actions. Carve-outs live here.

delegator.description: The party granting authority. Must hold authority from an earlier receipt in the same chain, or be the principal.

evidence_note.description: Human/machine-readable pointer to the evidence (internal log path, dated directive, campaign-log entry).

evidence_url.description: Public URL evidencing the delegation (brief, approval message, log). Null when evidence is internal; then evidence_note MUST say where it lives.

notes.description: Free-text context. Never used for authority; verifiers ignore it.

parent_receipt_id.description: Hash-chain link: the receipt_id of the immediately preceding receipt in the ledger, or the literal string GENESIS for the first receipt of a chain.

principal.description: The human at the root of this delegation. MUST be identical on every receipt in a chain and MUST be kind 'human'.

receipt_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON of the receipt body plus its signature object (see spec.md 'Hash-chaining rule').

schema_version.description: Schema version this receipt was minted under.

algorithm.description: operational-attestation: tamper-evidence seal (SHA-256 of the canonical body), NOT an identity proof. ed25519: production identity signature over the canonical body; key registry required.

key_id.description: REQUIRED for ed25519: identifier resolving in the chain's key registry.

signed_by.description: agent_id of the party that applied the seal / signature (the record-keeper attesting the receipt's accuracy).

value.description: For operational-attestation: 64-char SHA-256 hex of the canonical body. For ed25519: 128-char hex signature.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-09-15T20:35:00-04:00. See timestamp_precision for honesty grading.

timestamp_precision.description: exact: the stated time is known. approximate: known within the hour. day: only the calendar date is known; time is the conventional T00:00:00 marker in the stated offset, NOT a claim about the hour.

title: CWI Delegation Receipt
